scripts.package: next build && python3 -c "import zipfile, os; zf = zipfile.ZipFile('hostinger-deploy.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zf.write(os.path.join(r, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, f), 'out')) for r, d, files in os.walk('out') for f in files]; zf.close(); print('Ready: hostinger-deploy.zip')"
